nodes.label: GE Vernova
nodes.description: Global power generation, electrification, wind and services company.

nodes.label: Reliable electricity
nodes.description: Continuous affordable electricity for households, industry and digital infrastructure.

nodes.label: Power grid
nodes.description: Transmission, distribution, substations and grid-control infrastructure.

nodes.label: Heavy-duty gas turbines
nodes.description: Dispatchable generation technology supporting capacity growth and grid reliability.

nodes.label: AI data centers
nodes.description: Power-intensive compute infrastructure driving incremental electricity and grid demand.

nodes.label: Grid equipment capacity
nodes.description: Constrained transformer, switchgear, substation and related manufacturing capacity.

nodes.label: Transformer and electrical core-steel capacity
nodes.description: Limited transformer manufacturing capacity and electrical core-steel availability with extended procurement timelines and foreign dependence.

nodes.label: Large-load interconnection
nodes.description: Transmission and interconnection capacity, tariff and queue constraints affecting large data-center and industrial loads.

nodes.label: Astera Labs, Inc.
nodes.description: Astera Labs is structurally exposed to a real rack-scale AI bottleneck: accelerator growth increases pressure on scale-up fabric bandwidth, memory-semantic connectivity, signal integrity and fleet-level interoperability rather than compute alone.

nodes.label: scale-up connectivity demand
nodes.description: more accelerators require higher-bandwidth, lower-latency and more reliable data movement

nodes.label: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
nodes.description: AMD's 2036-relevant causal position is broader than accelerator silicon alone: Instinct GPUs, EPYC CPUs, Pensando networking and ROCm form a rack-scale stack that can convert hyperscaler/frontier-lab compute diversification into platform demand.

nodes.label: AMD rack-scale platform demand
nodes.description: customers add AMD accelerators, CPUs, networking and ROCm to diversify supply and optimize workload economics

nodes.label: Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd
nodes.description: AI accelerator scaling increases bandwidth, power-efficiency and reliability pressure on scale-out/scale-up interconnect; Credo's electrical/optical DSP, AEC, SiPho and diagnostics stack is directly exposed to that bottleneck.

nodes.label: high-speed interconnect demand
nodes.description: more accelerators and larger fabrics raise aggregate bandwidth while power and uptime constrain link choices

nodes.label: Applied Materials, Inc.
nodes.description: Applied Materials sits on the causal path from AI compute demand to leading-edge logic, DRAM and advanced-packaging capacity through materials-engineering/process equipment; Q3 Semiconductor Systems revenue was $7.04B with mix spanning foundry/logic 67%, DRAM 26% and flash 7%.

nodes.label: leading-edge logic/DRAM/advanced-packaging investment
nodes.description: Applied Materials sits on the causal path from AI compute demand to leading-edge logic, DRAM and advanced-packaging capacity through materials-engineering/process equipment; Q3 Semiconductor Systems revenue was $7.04B with mix spanning foundry/logic 67%, DRAM 26% and flash 7%.

nodes.label: Broadcom Inc.
nodes.description: Broadcom is exposed to two structural AI infrastructure bottlenecks at once: custom accelerator compute and scale-up/scale-out networking. Q3 FY2026 AI semiconductor revenue of $16.7B (+221% YoY) is realized evidence that those bottlenecks are currently monetizing rather than remaining TAM narrative.

nodes.label: custom accelerator demand
nodes.description: large labs seek optimized compute economics and architecture control

nodes.label: Vertiv Holdings Co
nodes.description: Vertiv sits directly on two present AI-infrastructure bottlenecks: high-density power delivery and thermal management. Its 2026 manufacturing expansions in power conversion, integrated infrastructure and liquid cooling are capacity responses to those constraints rather than a software/TAM proxy.

nodes.label: liquid cooling and high-density power demand
nodes.description: higher rack power creates heat-removal and power-conversion constraints

nodes.label: Rocket Lab Corporation
nodes.description: Rocket Lab sits on a causal path from growing civil, commercial and national-security orbital demand to launch, spacecraft and communications infrastructure: Q2 2026 revenue reached $234M, backlog $2.36B, and launch backlog exceeded 90 missions across Electron, HASTE and Neutron.

nodes.label: launch and spacecraft demand
nodes.description: Rocket Lab sits on a causal path from growing civil, commercial and national-security orbital demand to launch, spacecraft and communications infrastructure: Q2 2026 revenue reached $234M, backlog $2.36B, and launch backlog exceeded 90 missions across Electron, HASTE and Neutron.

nodes.label: NVIDIA Corporation
nodes.description: NVIDIA sits on a causal path from AI/accelerated-computing demand to integrated compute, networking and software infrastructure; Q2 FY2027 revenue was $96.221B and Compute & Networking $88.299B, while Blackwell remained the majority of system shipments and Vera Rubin entered production shipments in Q3 FY2027.

nodes.label: NVIDIA compute/networking platform demand
nodes.description: NVIDIA sits on a causal path from AI/accelerated-computing demand to integrated compute, networking and software infrastructure; Q2 FY2027 revenue was $96.221B and Compute & Networking $88.299B, while Blackwell remained the majority of system shipments and Vera Rubin entered production shipments in Q3 FY2027.

nodes.label: CoreWeave, Inc.
nodes.description: CoreWeave sits on the causal path from AI model demand to deployable accelerated-compute capacity by assembling scarce GPUs, energized datacenter power and cloud software into usable infrastructure; Q2 backlog near $104B and active power above 1 GW show realized demand and physical scaling rather than TAM alone.

nodes.label: accelerated cloud capacity demand
nodes.description: CoreWeave sits on the causal path from AI model demand to deployable accelerated-compute capacity by assembling scarce GPUs, energized datacenter power and cloud software into usable infrastructure; Q2 backlog near $104B and active power above 1 GW show realized demand and physical scaling rather than TAM alone.

nodes.label: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited
nodes.description: TSMC is a central manufacturing bottleneck linking AI compute demand to advanced-node wafers and advanced packaging; Q2 2026 revenue was US$40.20B with 67.7% gross margin, and Q3 guidance rose to US$44.6-45.8B.

nodes.label: advanced-node wafer demand
nodes.description: TSMC is a central manufacturing bottleneck linking AI compute demand to advanced-node wafers and advanced packaging; Q2 2026 revenue was US$40.20B with 67.7% gross margin, and Q3 guidance rose to US$44.6-45.8B.

nodes.label: Arm Holdings plc
nodes.description: Arm remains a foundational compute architecture/IP layer spanning mobile, edge and data center; FY2026 royalty revenue rose 21% and management attributes growth to higher-royalty Armv9 technology, while data-center royalty more than doubled year over year in Q4.

nodes.label: Arm-based chip deployments
nodes.description: Arm remains a foundational compute architecture/IP layer spanning mobile, edge and data center; FY2026 royalty revenue rose 21% and management attributes growth to higher-royalty Armv9 technology, while data-center royalty more than doubled year over year in Q4.

nodes.label: ASML Holding N.V.
nodes.description: ASML remains a structural bottleneck for leading-edge lithography: AI-driven advanced Logic and Memory capacity requires higher lithography intensity, while ASML is expanding low-NA EUV and DUV immersion capacity by about 30% for 2027 and investigating another roughly 30% increase for 2028.

nodes.label: ASML structural demand
nodes.description: ASML remains a structural bottleneck for leading-edge lithography: AI-driven advanced Logic and Memory capacity requires higher lithography intensity, while ASML is expanding low-NA EUV and DUV immersion capacity by about 30% for 2027 and investigating another roughly 30% increase for 2028.

nodes.label: Applied Digital Corporation
nodes.description: Applied Digital's defensible structural role is not generic AI demand but access to grid-connected, power-dense campus capacity that can be converted into long-duration hyperscaler leases; this is a real bottleneck while interconnection and powered-shell supply remain constrained.

nodes.label: demand for grid-connected high-density campuses
nodes.description: large accelerator clusters require scarce power, interconnection and purpose-built cooling/electrical infrastructure

nodes.label: KLA Corporation
nodes.description: KLA occupies a structural semiconductor yield-control bottleneck: as leading-edge logic, memory and advanced packaging become more complex, inspection/metrology/process-control requirements rise because defects and process variation become more economically costly.

nodes.label: inspection/metrology intensity
nodes.description: KLA occupies a structural semiconductor yield-control bottleneck: as leading-edge logic, memory and advanced packaging become more complex, inspection/metrology/process-control requirements rise because defects and process variation become more economically costly.

nodes.label: Analog Devices
nodes.description: Analog Devices sits on a causal path from electrification, industrial automation and AI/data-center power demand to mixed-signal sensing, conversion and power-management content; the current issuer evidence also adds Empower Semiconductor as a more direct power-delivery exposure.

nodes.label: high-density power-delivery demand
nodes.description: Analog Devices sits on a causal path from electrification, industrial automation and AI/data-center power demand to mixed-signal sensing, conversion and power-management content; the current issuer evidence also adds Empower Semiconductor as a more direct power-delivery exposure.

nodes.label: Intuitive Machines
nodes.description: Intuitive Machines is evolving from lunar-delivery exposure toward a broader space-infrastructure platform spanning spacecraft, communications and ground services; current primary evidence shows this scale in both acquired backlog and new awards.

nodes.label: integrated mission awards and backlog
nodes.description: spacecraft, communications and ground-service breadth allows capture of larger mission scope

structuralSignals.thesis: Record electricity demand from AI data centers and electrification increases the value of generation and grid capacity supplied by GE Vernova.
structuralSignals.falsifier: Sustained power-demand growth falls materially below current EIA expectations while data-center grid connection demand and GEV Electrification orders contract for multiple quarters.

structuralSignals.thesis: Long lead times and constrained power/grid equipment capacity support backlog visibility, disciplined underwriting and pricing power for suppliers with installed manufacturing capacity.
structuralSignals.falsifier: Industry lead times normalize rapidly, backlog growth stalls and GEV reports declining price contribution or material under-utilization of planned capacity.

structuralSignals.thesis: Scarce generation and electrification capacity plus lifecycle service relationships are allowing GEV to capture favorable price and expand margins.
structuralSignals.falsifier: Adjusted margins stop improving despite volume growth, or price becomes a negative driver while order demand remains high.

structuralSignals.thesis: As generation and grid manufacturing expand, transformer capacity and electrical core-steel availability can become successor bottlenecks that limit grid buildout and backlog conversion despite strong demand.
structuralSignals.falsifier: Transformer procurement lead times and domestic core-steel constraints normalize materially for multiple reporting periods while grid-equipment backlog and project delays remain elevated for unrelated reasons.

structuralSignals.thesis: Rising large-load demand increases dependence on transmission/interconnection capacity, making queue quality and actual grid connection progress a gating layer between announced data-center demand and realized equipment/generation demand.
structuralSignals.falsifier: Realized large-load connections and electricity sales materially undershoot EIA expectations while speculative queue requests are withdrawn without replacement demand or persistent interconnection pressure.

structuralSignals.thesis: Astera Labs is structurally exposed to a real rack-scale AI bottleneck: accelerator growth increases pressure on scale-up fabric bandwidth, memory-semantic connectivity, signal integrity and fleet-level interoperability rather than compute alone.
structuralSignals.falsifier: AI systems scale without rising merchant fabric/connectivity content per rack

structuralSignals.falsifier: named deployments fail to scale, utilization remains immaterial, or customers materially revert to incumbent/custom accelerators
